sourceEvidence.note: Recognizes client.terms-and-conditions, loads the authoritative current version through platform.clients.user.getContinuityPromotion(), submits acceptance through createContinuityPromotion(), keeps the returned continuity session client-local, and maps local accepted/rejected/failed completion paths.
Exposes the canonical current-version display, Termly View Terms link, Accept action, and Reject action.

notes: Exists is green because the stable React Native client has a platform dispatcher for client.terms-and-conditions and the intended handler.
Controls conform to authored version 2: current version + View Terms + Accept + Reject.
The card-local behavior is substantially implemented, including authoritative version retrieval and the acceptance operation.

Behavior Wired remains false because nuviot/ai-client AgentChatEngine does not yet project AgentExecuteResponse.clientDirectives into normalized Client Interaction state, no canonical Client Interaction completion submission/continuation contract exists yet, and the live mobile chat surface is therefore not connected to the complete agent round trip.
